notes.title: Microcosm Symphony: Deflector Emerges as GDWC 2023 Finalist!
notes.content:
Greetings, Microcosm Pioneers!

We're delighted to reveal that Deflector has earned its spot as a finalist in the Game Development World Championship 2023 Winter Season. The spotlight is on the "Accolade for Best Music," recognizing the enchanting melodies that weave through the intricate tapestry of your microcosmic journey.

🎵 [b]Accolade for Best Music: Deflector's Sonic Odyssey![/b]

Embark on a symphonic adventure within Deflector's microcosm, where every note is a testament to the immersive auditory experience. The harmonious compositions have struck a chord with the discerning GDWC judges, securing Deflector's place among the finalists in the coveted Best Music category.

📅 Date to Remember: [b]February 23rd, 2024[/b]

As we prepare for the grand revelation of winners on [b]February 23rd, 2024, in Tallinn, Estonia, at 19:00 / 7 pm local time[/b] (GMT+2), we extend an invitation to join us in this celebration of outstanding game development achievements. For those unable to attend in person, rest assured! The entire spectacle will be broadcasted live on [url=https://www.youtube.com/@thegdwc]the GDWC YouTube channel[/url].

🔗 GDWC Awards Show Details: [url=https://thegdwc.com/awards/]Link to Awards Show[/url]

But the symphony doesn't end there! We're elated to remind you that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1736550/view/3664289971001485909]the official Deflector soundtrack[/url], a fifteen-track masterpiece by Sam Kyle of Wide Dogg Studios, is available on major platforms including YouTube Music, Spotify, and Apple Music.

🔊 Downloadable Soundtrack on Steam:
For those who wish to own the soundtrack, it is available for download on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2331510/Deflector__Original_Soundtrack/

🎮 Explore and Enjoy:
Whether you choose to stream on popular platforms or secure your own copy on Steam, we invite you to immerse yourself in the captivating melodies of Deflector. Let the music enhance your gaming experience and transport you further into the microcosmic realms.

🎉 Share Your Favorites:
We're eager to hear your thoughts! Drop a comment and let us know which track from Deflector's official soundtrack has become your go-to banger. Your feedback and enthusiasm are the beating heart of our creative journey. Explore the comments section in the video below to discover the precise title of the composition:

Thank you for being part of the Deflector community. Now, let the music carry you into the depths of this extraordinary adventure!

notes.title: New Virus Strains & Anomalies
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/d86960b03bfa48c4cd1f4ba6e59d4066cfb4aa99.jpg[/img]
In Deflector it's always an evolutionary arms race between you and your bioshells, and the hostile envrionments. What new twisted threats can you look forward to post update? Let's find out!

[h3]New Virus Strains[/h3]
Virus strains represent an additional injection of difficulty into the already familiar environments. Whenever you play Virus Strains, you choose how many there will be. But as to what they will do? That is up to chance. And now there are several new ways that Virus Strains can turn out: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/6ff755bab5fed9a6398cc6b592752114e24eacd3.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Mixed virus:[/b] This area may contain enemies from all the areas. Maybe those Flipbugs got lost.
[*] [b]Overgrown viruses:[/b] Powerful enemies may now appear in Cell Extraction rooms. Don't get too relaxed!
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/75cf39d6effc1019f7edc520d2115ed7e731b0d8.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Fragile bullets:[/b] Most bullets may break when deflecting them. But they'll still hurt if you don't!
[*] [b]Vengeful virus:[/b] Some enemies may shoot a bullet at you on death. Best be ready for these little final gifts.
[/list]
[h3]New Anomalies[/h3]
Certain rooms on your playthrough may be affected by anomalies, and there are now several more that you can come across while exploring!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/8fd6e55cfb7a4c14df863f3cb9303a2554e3b801.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Lights off:[/b] Reduces vision.
[*] [b]Rockets:[/b] From time to time, rockets will appear and chase you.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/ef4f4a1aa6dfc48bcc1aefa126644e3ed9809285.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Poisonous ground:[/b] Poison puddles appear around the room from time to time.
[*] [b]Larvae swarm:[/b] Enemies spawn a Larvae when they die.
[/list]

We hope you are excited to experience all that the update has to offer! Do you have favorite anomalies and virus strains? Perhaps ones you just love to hate? Let us know in the comments!

notes.title: Challenging evolutions
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/7f86566866defed3aaeacc417092763aaf593323.jpg[/img]

In our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1736550/view/3664289970955762832?l=english]most recent update[/url] one of the newest additions to Deflector are brand new evolutions. For those of you that need a refresher - these are upgrades unique to each bioshell and acquired by defeating Great Viruses, the mid-bosses of Deflector's biomes.

Today we're taking a closer look at the brand new evolutions! There's one for each bioshell and each has to be unlocked through a challenge before you can acquire it. Let's dive in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/5fdb0c77b3816329e2e7518b5aca036024161d88.gif[/img]
[b]Bioshell:[/b] Eradicator
[b]Evolution name:[/b] Boomerang Orbit
[b]Evolution function:[/b] Every consecutive deflection of the boomerang generates a boomerang that will orbit around you. They are lost when retrieving the boomerang.
[b]Required challenge:[/b] As Eradicator, kill [b]10[/b] enemies with your boomerang before retrieving it.
This evolution is a real treat for the dedicated boomerang-bouncer which is reflected both in its challenge and in its function! Get those kills without ever catching your boomerang!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/41f8679893a54fe0d1c81706e9aeccfb6ff0854e.gif[/img]
[b]Bioshell:[/b] Slasher
[b]Evolution name:[/b] Combo Slash
[b]Evolution function:[/b] Defeating an enemy with Radial Slash will release a Radial Slash at the enemy's position.
[b]Required challenge:[/b] As Slasher, complete [b]3[/b] survival rooms without dashing nor receiving damage in a single game.
Radial Slash kills will now make enemies explode into an additional Radial Slash! Can you handle the challenge to unlock this powerful evolution?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/805367e074c220c934dfbaa428ce846dc7935b91.gif[/img]
[b]Bioshell:[/b] Gunslinger
[b]Evolution name:[/b] Wall Burst
[b]Evolution function:[/b] No longer shoot bullets while holding the wall, but release a burst.
[b]Required challenge:[/b] As Gunslinger, kill [b]100[/b] enemies with bullets deflected with your wall.
Project the entirety of your defensive wall at the enemy whenever you fire your weapon with it raised! Of course weaponizing your defenses in this way will require you to first prove you can do it by deflecting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/b9088634b1e3a6529d1922816890cc20d1b70c66.gif[/img]
[b]Bioshell:[/b] Spark
[b]Evolution name:[/b] Orb Blast
[b]Evolution function:[/b] Deflected orbs release a wave when hitting an enemy.
[b]Required challenge:[/b] As Spark, kill [b]10[/b] enemies with a single use of the active.
Spark's active ability packs a punch. This evolution's unlock condition challenges you to prove it by burning through a crowd of enemies in a single use! And in return you'll unlock the evolution to add more of a punch to your orbs as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/0c26b69f54e205e48b7c6f00599694a6e792bcf5.gif[/img]
[b]Bioshell:[/b] Lightfist
[b]Evolution name:[/b] Superfist
[b]Evolution function:[/b] Releasing deflect at full charge fires a piercing fist.
[b]Required challenge:[/b] As Lightfist, kill [b]6[/b] enemies with a single double punch of the active ability.
You might want to group up your enemies before trying that challenge. Your reward? Lightfist's fully charged fist becomes a full high-flying piercing projectile!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/45b7111b2f6e58daf14325271272a189277251bc.gif[/img]
[b]Bioshell:[/b] Corrupted
[b]Evolution name:[/b] Multiple Shards
[b]Evolution function:[/b] Release two additional Crystals Shard lines when attacking.
[b]Required challenge:[/b] As Corrupted, absorb [b]10[/b] bullets with a single absorb.
That's one challenge for the specimen with a voracious appetite. Fed on enemy projectiles the Corrupted will be able to evolve to release three rows of crystalline shards with every attack!

And that sums up all the new evolutions added to Deflector! We hope you enjoy the update. Share your experience in the comments below!

notes.title: Deflector's Summer major update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/34b710f5afd8f5f22d8bd9e513de64df0e0bec82.png[/img]

Greetings, Specimens! You may have witnessed the full release of Deflector, but we did tell you updates were still going to happen! And it's time for a big one.

This scorching Summer update brings with it multiple ways to become stronger both for you, and for your dire foes. We'll cover them in great detail further down the line, but for now let's dive right in with the broad strokes.

[previewyoutube=RUrGrfSKUng;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]New evolutions for each bio-shell[/h3]
Whether you just can't stop bouncing boomerangs as the Eradicator or bully viruses with Lightfist's punches - every bio-shell in the game is getting a brand new evolution! Unlocking them however isn't as simple as looking the Deflector AI straight in the eye(s) and saying "Pretty please". You'll have to complete a challenge to unlock each of them. 

[h3]New virus strains[/h3]
Since you've been doing so well against the existing virus strains it's time to add some new ones to the mix. With a total of four, you'll find them doing interesting things to the bullets you're used to deflecting and the enemies you're used to seeing in a given biome. 

[h3]New anomalies[/h3]
Rockets and larvae and poison puddles - oh my!

[h3]New languages added to the game[/h3]
Deflector is now available in Traditional Chinese and Japanese!

[h3]Balance tweaks to Lightfist's Multiple Strike Evolution[/h3]
Now breaking 6 marks instead of 3 and having twice the range!

We are far from done with Deflector and you can expect more updates further down the line. In the meantime - have fun in the petri dish!

notes.title: Bioshells - Unlock them all!
notes.content:
Since Deflector's release we've been seeing more of you ask how to unlock new bioshells for your use. That is understandable! And that is why we're publishing this guide. Let's go down the list of bioshells and clarify how each one can be unlocked for your use. 

[list]
[*][h3][b]Name:[/b] Eradicator[/h3]
[*][h3][b]Unlock condition:[/b] Begin the Deflector experiment[/h3]
[/list]
Eradicator is your initial bioshell. His boomerang is open to every new participant in the Deflector experiment!

[list]
[*][h3][b]Name:[/b] Slasher[/h3]
[*][h3][b]Unlock condition:[/b] Learn enough about Deflector[/h3]
[/list]
Slasher is a short-range combat specialist. The Deflector AI will unlock access to him automatically as you are learning about the experiment. Just keep setting out on your runs and you will eventually be introduced to bioshell selection and given Slasher as a sampler. 

[list]
[*][h3][b]Name:[/b] Gunslinger[/h3]
[*][h3][b]Unlock condition:[/b] Defeat any Apex Virus 10 times[/h3]
[/list]
Gunslinger is a bioshell that lets you focus on long range. To unlock him, you need only defeat any [b]Apex Virus[/b] 10 times. Every Apex Virus you beat counts towards that goal, so you can strike at different worlds in order, or just go on repeat runs against the one you have mastered beating consistently.

[list]
[*][h3][b]Name:[/b] Lightfist[/h3]
[*][h3][b]Unlock condition:[/b] Defeat a Great Virus and an Apex Virus in the same run without using your regular attack[/h3]
[/list]
Lightfist is a bioshell named after her trademark weapon and unlocking her tests your ability to deflect and mastery over alternative sources of damage. Remember the condition only applies to Great Viruses and Apex Viruses, so you don't have to forgo your regular attack for the entire run - only the midboss and final boss of any one world. Still, the challenge is tricky. Remember to buff your [b]Deflect attribute[/b] to make deflected projectiles more damaging and pay attention to your mutations. There are those that activate in response to dashing or deflecting, making them handy in clearing this challenge. You're allowed to use the active skill of your bioshell as well, so long as it doesn't require use of your regular attack.

[list]
[*][h3][b]Name:[/b] Spark[/h3]
[*][h3][b]Unlock condition:[/b] Help the robot find the lost bioshell[/h3]
[/list]
Spark is lost at the start of the game. It will take solving a puzzle to bring her back and make her available for your use. Not to give the whole puzzle away, but start by going into Living Entrails and checking behind the waterfall of blood in the very first area you are taken to. From there you'll need to travel to different biomes until you've finally collected all the clues!

[list]
[*][h3][b]Name:[/b] Corrupted[/h3]
[*][h3][b]Unlock condition:[/b] Defeat the Source[/h3]
[/list]
Corrupted is locked away behind the [b]Source[/b]. Defeating it is the one condition to unlocking this bioshell. Of course that means you will need to survive all the way to the final boss and then beat it, so don't expect an easy prize. 



That's it for the bioshells unlockable in Deflector! Which ones have you unlocked already? Which ones have given you trouble? Let us know and enjoy the game!

notes.title: The full release update!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=oRjK8_DmImE;full][/previewyoutube]
The wait is over and the Deflector experiment is now fully operational. To those of you who have been with us through Early Access - thank you. And to those of you who are first discovering the game - welcome. Both of you can read on to see all the juiciest and most enticing additions to Deflector. 

[h2]Six Bioshells[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/4ff8688e9ccfeb0be5c0fc29fa962929b3558795.gif[/img]

In the full version of Deflector, unlock up to six different bioshells, each with a unique set of weapons, abilities and ways to Deflect projectiles. The Corrupted, the newest bioshell to join Deflector, is an unusual one to say the least, and it’s only by overcoming the new two-stage incarnation of the final boss that you can get him!

[h2]Survival Chamber[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/51807df9c291f60d468c5fdd4ef2958d0fde4862.gif[/img]

A new mode of play perfect for those with a competitive streak! Defend the Hub from approaching bombs while being relentlessly assaulted by viruses both big and small. This mode of play is unlocked by playing Deflector.

Survival Chamber also comes with a global leaderboard, showing your results against every eager participant of the experiment out there! We plan to make use of that leaderboard very soon, so keep an eye out for an announcement.

[h2]Virus Strains[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/849a2a4806a70d7eaa2f965e0b34f0e5cbdcfcca.gif[/img]

In this new end game mode, you get to build your own difficulty! Choose to inject each biome with up to five Virus Strains, each resulting in an additional random debuff. This mode is not only a way to keep you on your toes even when you’ve mastered all that the path to the final boss can offer! It’s also tied to the new Proficiency system. 

With Proficiency, each bioshell now has a list of five permanent buffs, unlockable through Virus Strains. Feeling particularly confident about your Eradicator boomerang game? Want to show you can really shine as Spark? Challenge the Virus Strains with your favorite bioshells and grow stronger with each level of Virus Strain you have beaten.

[h2]Moving forward[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/317dcd83a49ff3b780bace195c6c9f0804c9cf8c.gif[/img]

Although Deflector is now available in its fully released version, that doesn’t mean work on it is finished for good. We will continue to work hard to balance, update, and keep Deflector a great game to play. You can look below for a full list of changes and tweaks. In the meantime - have a wonderful time in the petri dish, Specimens!

[h2]Patch notes[/h2]

[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*] New bioshell, Corrupted, added to the game with 5 unique bioshell mutations
[*] New final world map added
[*] Final boss now has a second stage
[*] New end game mechanic: “Virus strains”
[*] Proficiency level added to every bioshell
[*] New outfit added for every bioshell
[*] New game mode: “Survival Chamber” with leaderboards
[*] New enemy type: Champions
[*] Character selection screen and UI updated

[*] Dialogue UI updated and new dialogues have been added
[*] New sound for UI and dialogues
[*] New room types added (Blood extraction and Nest)
[*] DNA upgrades fully reworked
[*] Added save slots to the game
[*] New music track added to Hollow Hive Apex Virus fight
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Active ability no longer charges from deflecting, but from damaging enemies with your main weapon or deflected projectiles.
[*] Bioshell unlock challenges updated for Spark and Lightfist
[*] DNA is now received at the end of every room rather than drop from enemies
[*] Damage numbers now change color based on type of damage. Enemy health bars are also adjusted based on max health and type of enemy
[/list]
[h3]Balance[/h3]

[list]
[*] Hub healing station base health reduced (30⏩25)
[/list]
[b]Bioshells[/b]

[list]

notes.title: Update 0.8.1 - New Tricks

[h3]Greetings, everyone! [/h3]
Our previous update has brought along some major changes (some of which we also examined in greater detail in subsequent articles). And what does [b]Deflector[/b] do in response to change? It adapts! So today we would like to announce our next update and the bag of new trick it comes with. 

What’s more, the [b]Winter Sale[/b] is on, so read until the end to find out about the bargain we have in store for you on the freshly updated Deflector!

Let’s kick off with changes to the Specimens. Some have more and some have fewer but they’ll all have an effect:

[h3]Slasher[/h3]
[list]
[*] Slasher’s attacks now have increased range;
[*] Slasher now generates Rage when dealing damage to enemies with his basic attack;
[*] When Rage is available, Slasher’s Deflect ability consumes it, becoming wider and dealing more damage based on the amount of Rage consumed; 
[*] Slasher throws a sword by holding down and releasing Deflect. This consumes Rage. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/7246f3d6da2129cbeb42ef9bc31630a584e2b353.gif[/img]
[h3]Gunslinger[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gunslinger no longer has infinite range and his shots gain some spread;
[*] Gunslinger’s Deflect ability now creates a deflecting screen that you can hold, drastically lowering your movement speed while you defend yourself;
[*] Gunslinger’s active ability can now spawn up to 3 turrets by pressing the active ability button again within the first 5 seconds.
[/list]
[h3]Spark[/h3]
[list]
[*] Spark’s active ability now fires a beam of light that deals damage and pierces through enemies.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/d26c9b6020969d0f1f860ecd720c9a45627623f7.gif[/img]
[h3]Lightfist[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lightfist now marks enemies by hitting them with deflected projectiles; 
[*] Hitting marked enemies with Lightfist’s punches breaks the marks and inflicts additional damage; 
[*] Lightfist’s Deflect now pushes enemies. If this causes the enemy to collide with an object, it takes significant damage.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/a4bb5b69a4493e6a3da1b899b52848a345955ed7.gif[/img]

Your foes aren’t without some changes either! The following Great and Apex Viruses have been updated: 

[h3]Great Viruses[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]The Serpent’s[/b] wave attack has been reworked; 
[*] [b]Obelisk’s[/b] attacks have been improved. The fight should be more dynamic now!
[/list]
[h3]Apex Virus[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Horned Giant[/b] has made some renovations to its arena, changing its shape;
[*] [b]Horned Giant[/b] had an overhaul to its attacks, with some being removed; 
[*] [b]Horned Giant[/b] now summons two walls in the second phase of the fight. They will shoot lines of projectiles periodically 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/06078cc9887ee8c90dff05b1299c78b9f55ecf2d.gif[/img]

While those are some of the changes easy to put a Specimen or Virus’ nametag to, there’s also a slew of other improvements to the game! Here’s a list of more general changes you’ll find in the game following this update: 
[list]
[*] Some specimen evolutions have been updated to match the changes to the Specimens;
[*] Great and Apex viruses can now be affected by Altered states;
[*] Freeze now reduces the affected enemy’s movement speed and projectile velocity instead of stunning. Bonus effects have been upgraded accordingly; 
[*] 4 new mutations added to the roster. They’ll be unlocked by default;
[*] 4 additional new mutations added to the roster. They’ll be unlocked by increasing your Research Level;
[*] Inner Roots (Nucleolus) now roots the enemy and deals damage; 
[*] Little Crawler (Nucleolus) added. It summons spider minions to aid you in combat!
[/list]

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Resolved issue that caused chasing laser anomaly to appear too close;
[*] Resolved game occasionally softlocking when pausing just before Oogles picked you up at the end of the room;
[*] Resolved anomalous Toxic Tentacle behavior causing them to sometimes not appear/reappear properly. 
[/list]

That’s it for the update! 

What’s more, you can pick up Deflector with all its most up-to-date features at a [b]25% discount[/b]! Deflector is part of the Winter Sale and is available at this special festive price from Dec 22, 2022 - Jan 5, 2023 10am Pacific. Don’t miss it!

notes.title: New ways to mutate!
notes.content:
In our previous article we recapped the map of the distinct and deadly microcosms of Deflector. Today let's talk about mutations! They've been with you for a long time now, but, appropriately, the entire range available to you has been changing and growing. Without further ado, here's the newest mutations that emerged in the Deflector Experiment.

[b]Impale[/b] - Damaging an enemy with your weapon has a chance to generate a damaging spike from below. Its damage scales with your [i]Attack Attribute[/i].

[b]Explosive Bullets[/b] - Deflected bullets have a chance of exploding upon hitting an enemy. The explosion damage scales with your [i]Deflect Attribute[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/9725d20e10610df605a98f1fcaa2b3b9922aa6c3.gif[/img]

[b]Extended Immunity [/b]- You remain invulnerable after taking damage for a longer time.

[b]Blood Extraction[/b] - Defeated enemies drop health orbs. They can be picked up off the ground for a limited time. Your [i]Health Attribute[/i] affects the amount of health restored.

[b]Bouncing Star[/b] - Your first attack after dashing releases a shuriken at the nearest enemy. The shuriken then bounces between enemies several times, dealing damage based on your [i]Attack Attribute[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/e53eb3eede8c3e8bb2737a4990d453d87297f44b.gif[/img]

[b]Charged Discs[/b] - Every few seconds without deflecting you charge a disc, up to 3 in total. The next time you deflect a projectile the discs will be shot at nearby enemies, dealing damage based on your [i]Deflect Attribute[/i].

[b]Swiftness Steal[/b] - Killing an enemy restores a dash charge.

[b]Portable Medkit[/b] - Summon a healing bot at the end of every combat room. It restores health based on your [i]Health Attribute[/i]. This mutation is disabled for one combat room after visiting a Safe Point. 

Have you already had a chance to use these mutations? Did any of them become your favorite? Let us know, and stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Know your maps!
notes.content:
Have you been enjoying the new update? Between the new enemies, the switch to DNA Table and complete map overhaul, even some of the old became a lot newer. To help your participation in the Deflector experiment remain smooth, we’ve decided to detail certain new aspects. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/87031777ded9875aabd8be95786bb9d6180b1979.gif[/img]

Today let's take a look at the map and some new room markers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/9bf7d4cdf5c6f9e28ec335b60cbfa555709275fc.png[/img]

Progress in the Deflector Experiment has allowed for more consistent rewards as you clear rooms of viruses. A reminder in the top right of the screen while you’re exploring any of the four worlds will help keep track of all the icons. But what do they mean? 

[h3]Mutation Source[/h3]
Clearing a Mutation Source room is what is going to help you acquire new mutations to make yourself stronger and add new abilities!

[h3]Growth[/h3]
Survive a Growth room and you will be able to upgrade one of your Attributes. Remember, among other things Attributes affect the scaling of your mutations.

[h3]Cell Extraction[/h3]
Exterminate the enemies and you will receive an amount of Cells. They’ll come in handy when visiting the…

[h3]Cell Exchange[/h3]
This is one of the rooms that will let you take a breather. This is where you will be able to turn in the Cells you have earned and acquire upgrades!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/af76e70b1a33d0dad2a388884693d1aeb45b491b.gif[/img]

[h3]Safe Point[/h3]
Another sight for sore eyes - a room where you will be able to restore your health and take a break from foes and projectiles. Not for long however. And certainly not with the remaining three room types.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/64cd5270b90699c04a8e5f26c879b51f5f97cb0d.gif[/img]

[h3]Survival[/h3]
Chock full of enemies and traps. Your goal is to survive for a limited time and move on!

[h3]Great Virus[/h3]
You’ll always find one in the middle of the map. The Great Virus is a ruthless midboss barring your way to the ultimate challenge of a given biome. Beat one and Evolve with a specimen-unique upgrade!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/75abb7cfd098d426370d16c5cf3f3aeeced4e866.gif[/img]

[h3]Apex Virus[/h3]
As before, the pinnacle of a world’s challenges is the massive Apex Virus. The last room on every map. But will it be the last room on your journey…?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/ba1df3eef3e905a193053e143a5a4f6a20c7ad49.gif[/img]

Now you know what every room marker on a map means! We hope you find them helpful and don't get lost!

notes.title: Improved systems & big monsters
notes.content:
We hope you’re keeping your copy of [b]Deflector[/b] up-to-date because today it’s time for an update. And it’s one of the big ones! [b]“Improved systems & big monsters”[/b] might seem like a bit of a giveaway, but there’s more to see, so let’s go down the list!

You’ve had your share of filling out the DNA Table, but now it’s time for something more compressed. More of a board. So let’s meet your DNA Board!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/ed328af0f8c58963fe0c2eb450d4a1a2be7e772d.png[/img]

This neat and tidy board packs a lot of information about you, your mutations, abilities and their performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/f02cea4bdb34bf77d81a131c4c5ec42ded2f6e76.png[/img]

You now have three attributes:
[list]
[*] ATTACK affects the damage you deal with your attacks
[*] DEFLECT affects the damage you deal with deflected bullets
[*] HEALTH affects your maximum health
[/list]
In addition to that, each attribute affects mutations of the corresponding color. Such as red mutations being affected by your Attack Attribute. You can see an example below

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/0b3882ffb369faf1712cf78e551a025061fd6f8c.png[/img]

But wait. What are those extra icons on each of the Mutations? Those are called altered states, and every mutation you come across will have one. Altered states don’t depend on specific mutations or attributes, but stacking them together by having multiple mutations with a similar altered state will increase the effect.

Whether increasing your attributes, gathering Cells or mutations, you will of course do it all on the map. You’ll notice that it too has gone through an overhaul. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/11de950b7e045227040674ece90e7e0a199b175f.gif[/img]

The legend in the upper left should help you identify nodes you’re looking for. Hovering over them will tell you what you can count on as well. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/92ff5da78ba449c2d5fd8199c56f512d64319392.png[/img]

Where before you would mostly identify the threat by the type of node but not be certain about the rewards, this time rewards are guaranteed. Growth will allow you to increase one of your three attributes. Mutation source will award a mutation. Survival nodes (now with many more traps) will upgrade the tier of your slotted mutation and so on. 

You may have noticed Evolutions and Nucleolus on the DNA Board earlier. While Nucleolus is the already familiar great mutation received from an Apex Virus, Evolutions as specimen-specific mutations. How do you receive them? By confronting Great Viruses.

These formidable foes mark the midpoint of each biome’s map. You may recognize them from one of our articles earlier this month! Depending on the biome you’ll run into one of them. Beat these Great Viruses and you’ll leave the confrontation evolved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/06e1deefe6e7ad246fadeecaa6429763cc1d8ba0.png[/img]

Of course, alternatively, you might also die. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/5b7b3795b38075ec194ee2879a8c4c59dc4cb1f2.png[/img]

This is a great time to talk about another important new term - Research Level. KarlOS has been going up in the world! Every concluded run, whether successful or successfully turned into a cautionary tale, will boost your Research Level at KarlOS’ lab, and with it - unlocking brand new mutations. Once they are unlocked you have a chance of having them drop while clearing biomes.

To sum things up! 

[list]
[*] This update overhauls the map, nodes and rewards you earn from them;
[*] The DNA Table is replaced with the DNA Board, including altered states on every Mutation and three Attributes that affect both your stats and the power of your mutation;
[*] Research Level replaces having to purchase mutations in the Hub. Leave it to KarlOS to help you unlock more mutations for the pool!
[*] The virus evolves in new ways, resulting in Great Viruses emerging in every biome.
[/list]
No time like the present to see it all for yourself! In fact, [b]Deflector[/b] is available at a [b]20% discount until November 29th[/b] in case you or your friends are still on the fence about the experiment.

[previewyoutube=6FXpzY-yv94;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]The full list of changes is as follows:[/h2]

[h3]What’s new[/h3]
[list]
[*] 8 new mutations have been added;
[*] All mutations have been updated/improved and now deal damage based on your attributes (Attack, Deflect , Health);
[*] World maps have been completely reworked. All rooms now drop a reward, including random mutation and random upgrade drops;
[*] Great Viruses added to every biome;
[*] Survival areas now have unique layouts full of traps;
[*] New deflectable objects added to maps in every biome;
[*] DNA Table replaced by DNA Board;
[*] Mutations now unlocked by increasing Research Level. Increase it by playing the game!
[*] Quest system removed;
[*] New enemy, Jellyfish, has been added to the Toxic Sea. It will chase you and apply poison;
[*] Ermit (Toxic Sea) no longer becomes invulnerable while hidden inside shell, but will release toxic puddles if damaged while hiding. Ermit also has different attack patterns; 
[/list]
[h3]Specimens[/h3]
[b]Lightfist[/b]
Note: These are temporal changes as we are examining the deflection mechanics
- Deflect no longer affects bullet speed;
- Lightfist’s movement speed is no longer reduced while charging deflect;
- Start and end deflect damage values have been changed;

[h3]Balance[/h3]
Slightly decreased amount of health regained at Hub Healer and Safe Point as well as the effect of upgrades on the amount healed;

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
Bloodleech no longer shoots its tongue while frozen.

[b]Lightfist[/b] lets you dream of punching every virus in the face (or the closest thing they have to a face). However, even this desire has nuance to it, so here's a reminder on how to up your Lightfist game.

[b]Remember to charge. [/b]
Your right punch is killer when it comes to deflecting projectiles, but if you just tap them it's not going to give them much speed or damage. Really hurt them by holding it down until it's fully charged. Then unleash and you'll make those projectiles fly fast and hit hard!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/79cae7cfc74c9a9e2639c7ebee968a6933d7ccbe.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/a787204aa4603ca3d4ae42a70e8bcdd4a131bb74.gif[/img]

[b]Stay on the move.[/b]
Learn to judge the range of your dodge. When your deflecting punch is fully charged, that range is going to shrink, but you'll still be able to move! Watch those attacks to make sure you see them coming. Dodge and weave while holding your charge for the right time. It's a shorter dodge, but it'll get you out of trouble.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/94ead562bf6b246e1977fa94944d8416e7d666d1.gif[/img]

notes.title: ⚡️ Meet new Specimen: Lightfist!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1736550/Deflector/]Deflector’s[/url] brand new Specimen is drawing nearer. Near enough for us to reveal her stunning looks and punchy playstyle! Meet [b]Lightfist[/b], who you’ll be able to select as your bioshell starting from the next update. And without further ado, let’s see what kinds of abilities she can flex. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/a74ef2679a1f30665327d854ad05a75c434775e1.png[/img]

Your basic left-click attack launches a punch in front of you. Punish your enemies with the old one-two punch!
Your deflecting ability lets you punch away projectiles! But it’s a bit more elaborate than just punching bullets. If you hold down the button, you’ll start charging your deflecting punch. At maximum power it will send enemy projectiles flying back with greater force, making them inflict more damage! Time it just right (you’ll know it’s time when you hear a sound and see a visual effect) and you’ll also shoot forward a giant fist for even more damage! You are not immobile while charging, but your movement speed and range of your dash are reduced. Use them to position yourself just right to deflect the most projectiles and dish out pain!
Finally your ultimate ability transforms your attacks into fierce ground pounds. For a time Lightfist’s every strike will slam both fists into the earth like an angry ten-finger meteor, dealing AoE damage on impact.

If you’ve been paying attention, you’ll know that the update is also introducing a new system, replacing Variants with Evolution, which unlocks Specimen-specific mutations as you unlock your DNA table. Let’s lift the veil and see what sorts of tricks Lightfist can evolve to use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/52d10e0c6b7caf8f5d104ee495c385fd15d958a9.jpg[/img]

[b]Running punch[/b]
Attacking after dashing hits with both arms in the direction you are aiming.

[b]Multiple parry[/b]
Perfect parry releases 3 fists in a cone.

[b]Ghost fists[/b]
Your fists pierce enemies, but deal less damage.

[b]Charge strike[/b]
Upon reaching maximum deflection charge, release a wave that damages nearby enemies.

[b]Great fists[/b]
Your attacks fire both fists, increasing damage at the cost of attack rate

And there you have it! Lightfist is coming with the next update. But the Evolution system and the new Specimen aren’t all that’s coming. There’s a new threat too. More on that in our next news article. Stay tuned!

P.S. visit our [url=https://twitter.com/arrowfistgames]Twitter[/url] to see Lightfist in action!

notes.title: Specimens evolution system 🧬
notes.content:
One of the major changes coming to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1736550/Deflector/]Deflector[/url] in the next update relates to the way Specimens evolve in the game. Those of you who have played will recognize the screen below, where you would select one of three Variants for your chosen bioshell.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/0d673a3297b9b383297a2ca180cc8982a9268a3a.png[/img]

Following the next update, Variants will be no more – each bioshell will begin in its default form emphasizing its base playstyle. As you clear viruses and unlock new traits on your DNA table, your chosen Specimen will eventually evolve.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/986248c5b4cfb60b6d87499053b8459f7bc336d9.gif[/img]

Every time your Specimen evolves you get to choose between two out of five mutations unique to the Specimen you’ve chosen. You can look up each bioshell’s potential mutations when you first select which one you want to use. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/18cd0c5ef9dec56ffadbcd8f9042e7e3bd07f86c.png[/img]

You unlock a new mutation at 4, 12 and 22 traits. That means you can have up to three mutations to shape your bioshell! The counter in the middle of the DNA table is going to tell you how many traits you still need to unlock in the table to Evolve. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/464c324ea9659a85d402ba0567c86c3fde4d9125.png[/img]
 
A Specimen that survives long enough to accumulate all three mutations gains abilities surpassing their original form! Let’s examine what sorts of mutations each bioshell can acquire.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/43a0aa8439cb77ba38d98e533f66e89e70dd176f.jpg[/img]
[b]Growing Boomerang[/b]
Your boomerang increases size the more you deflect it.

[b]Explosive Boomerang[/b]
Every 3 consecutive times you deflect the boomerang it releases a damaging explosion at its max distance.

[b]Side Boomerang[/b]
You can throw an additional boomerang, but your boomerangs deal less damage.

[b]Quick Boomerang[/b]
Deflecting or throwing your boomerang immediately after dashing charges it, significantly increasing damage, travel speed and range.

[b]Linked Boomerang[/b]
A laser connects you and the boomerang, continuously damaging enemies it touches.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/7112296d8666ee1815a6a25fe2beccef4b116f92.jpg[/img]
[b]Sword waves[/b]
Reduce base damage, but release flying swords with each attack attacks that deal a small amount of damage.

[b]Long sword[/b]
Your basic attack has increased range.

[b]Wide throw[/b]
The sword is now thrown horizontally and deals more damage.

[b]Triple sword[/b]
Release 2 additional swords in a cone when throwing the sword.

[b]Radial fast-slash[/b]
Attacking after a dash releases a 360-degree attack.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/55350bf9981077cb97c855212e95be8a84652365.jpg[/img]
[b]Turret protection[/b]
Your turret deploys an area that increases your damage and reduces damage taken.

[b]Split shooting[/b]
Your gun shoots 2 additional bullets in a cone.

[b]Overcharged bolts[/b]
Your shotgun has an additional charge and deals more damage.

[b]Piercing bolts[/b]
Bullets pierce enemies but deal less damage.

[b]Bolstered bolts[/b]
Greatly reduce rate of fire, but increase damage and size of bullets.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/0c37a3773c86dd0c4024a32f7a62915a583dc30a.jpg[/img]
[b]Orbs expansion[/b]
You are orbited by two additional orbs.

[b]Unstable orbs[/b]
The orbs explode when retrieved instead of traveling back.

[b]Far-charged orbs[/b]
Deflected orbs deal less damage up close, but fly further and deal increased damage the further they travel.

[b]Powerful Orbs[/b]
When using Expanded Orbit, the orbs become bigger and deal more damage.

[b]Skillful orbs[/b]
When using Expanded Orbit, initial spin speed is slower but increases over time.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/57bda80c1a2b2c255124174b551acb0c4a04f30a.jpg[/img]
On second thought, maybe this last one deserves special mention another time. Look forward to it very soon!

notes.title: ⚙️ Gunslinger & Spark upcoming changes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Not so long ago we mentioned Deflector’s 4th upcoming update. It’s about time we started pinning down some details for you! Today we’ll be putting Gunslinger and Spark under the microscope to show you the overhaul that they’ve gone through.

[b]Gunslinger[/b]
Gunslinger is still armed to the teeth, but the way his ammo works has gone through some changes. Where before the energy gauge (seen as a white arch under your feet) would be spent from firing your primary weapon, it is now responsible for your powerful deflective shotgun blast.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/0966b8da4699892ea6e954aa83068d1ab9a5610d.gif[/img] 

The two shotgun shell icons above the Gunslinger’s head show you how many you have left. Killing enemies refills your gauge which (by default) maxes out at two shots with which to deflect enemy projectiles and generally ruin their day. The gauge also gradually refills over time, so patience has its own rewards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/7539d525f3249a75d09c5d4a8eaf64bd7ed81466.gif[/img]
 
You’ll also notice Gunslinger only has two dash charges you can use back to back. But if you time your shots, dodges and shotgun blasts, you can wreak a lot of havoc. Your ultimate ability still spawns your turret buddy to multiply firepower.
 

[b]Spark[/b]
Spark has gone through some major changes. Where before your basic left click attack only recalled the orbs launched with your deflect ability, you can now hold it down to make them orbit  you at a certain distance. The orbs damage enemies as they pass through them, so by positioning yourself right you can get consistent damage. Even through obstacles!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/fb38a2f7ccf8a312e57d1cbb17c4781f22821152.gif[/img]
 
You deflect bullets by launching your orbs at them. Time your deflection as one of your orbs passes in front of you to send it flying through projectiles and enemies alike. Your left click will recall any orbs you have launched, dealing damage to enemies they pass on their way back! Other than deflecting projectiles, this can also serve as a source of heavy damage against enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/5e4a7a17ac4c9f9ee5449cbeded7b428be86bbea.gif[/img] 

So now that your spinning orbs are your basic means of attack, what does Spark’s ultimate do? Well, in an appropriately sparking display you’ll transform into a bolt of lightning for a few seconds. This lets you move around at a high speed, dealing damage to everything in your path.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/d781356c2a234c29557a7d6a9859639d343c0687.gif[/img]

We can’t wait for you to get your hands on the updated Gunslinger and Spark, but there are other major changes and additions in store as well. Find out more about them in the coming weeks!

notes.title: Tips & Tricks #2
notes.content:
We hope you liked our previous Tips & Tricks drop, because we’ve got a new one for you! 

1. Enemies only get aggroed at a certain range. Clear only those you have already engaged to manage a smaller number of enemies, or roam the arena fast to group your enemies together!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/c4ed9ee6308b096432921ed486f15b2a143b7821.gif[/img]

2. Blood ponds and rivers in Living Entrails will slow you down! You won’t drown from stepping into them, but unless you have a dash ready you might end up too slow to dodge incoming projectiles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/22d29bc5a3954d4b04413876035fa06206795f89.gif[/img]

3. The poison in Toxic Sea does not damage you until the poison bar is completely filled. The bar also empties over time. Dipping your toe in the poison to dodge certain attacks (especially when fighting the Tentacles) won’t immediately damage you. Just be careful not to spend too much time exposed to it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/24f371bf2beb914fb725545b90912256087d3aa7.gif[/img]

4. When you have a choice between deflecting or dashing to defend yourself, always go for deflection. Ending up without a dash at the crucial moment all but guarantees you’ll take damage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/f75e1f0ea6968741e02c06378b2c1b90f317e020.gif[/img]

5. Large spike bullets always split into several smaller bullets when they collide with anything, even with other enemies. Watch out for where they impact so you can be ready to deal with each projectile!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/aafa5e54d32b1a696931365779776595699361c8.gif[/img]

As always, we’d love to hear what sorts of tactics you’ve come up with while playing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1736550/Deflector/]Deflector[/url]. Share away in the comments!

notes.title: Updated roadmap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/308f2cd52a5d45d322683cc334e8088dfe57acbe.png[/img]

The world of Deflector may be microscopic, but there are big things happening! Our previous update added a brand new location and its associated Apex Virus. Now let’s talk about what’s coming. We are happy to present an update to our roadmap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/c9dbe73135c6f2776172ad6dff32055673310630.png[/img]

The 4th update to Deflector is on the way, bringing with it a number of major additions and updates. No doubt the addition of a new specimen for you to play as is the big highlight here, but that’s not all!
Current specimens are going to get some love and some updates as well. We will be introducing changes to the way they mutate and the way you acquire unique variants on their play style. You can look forward to a more detailed summary of which direction each of them is going.

The Source of the virus, serving as your final challenge and last boss of the game, is getting an update as well. Bigger, meaner, with gameplay and visuals reworked!

That’s Q3. Moving forward you can expect another major update in the last quarter of this year. It will add new Elite enemies, expand the pool of available mutations, introduce new types of rooms and mix up the DNA table.

Then it’s on to a full release in Q1 2023!
There’s a lot to look forward to and we can’t wait for you to experience it firsthand. Keep an eye out for more!

notes.title: 🛠 Hivestorm update is out today!
notes.content:
The wait is over! [b]The Hivestorm update[/b] is out today! We think it’s a good time to recap all that there is to see in the new world and beyond it. 

[previewyoutube=PLPiNrgR0t4;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Travel into the Hollow Hive[/b]

The Hollow Hive is the fourth world in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1736550/Deflector/]Deflector[/url]. A world of soil and the skittering sound of insect legs. The virus here clearly took inspiration from some creepy crawlies, and they’re coming for you as you intrude on their violent domain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/4301a65be7c39d7a4c859100bbe4daad67e84fff.png[/img]

At the top of the food-chain here are the [b]Giant Centipedes[/b]. This deadly trio will keep you on your toes not just with projectiles, but with rapid burrowing and reemerging from the ground. Stay on the move. There’s little room to wait patiently for the shots to reach you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/ddbeff677db88623243a79c2790efe203cc21f56.png[/img]

If you can overcome the Giant Centipedes, you’ll be rewarded with one of two powerful mutations tied to your active ability. 

[list]
[*] [b]Rock Skin[/b] surrounds you with a shell of stone, making you invincible for a short period of time.
[*] [b]Inner Roots[/b] releases a wide cobweb that roots all enemies affected.
[/list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/e741190ad3cbfc2396214e632c7db3a88d5664f1.png[/img]

We know you probably can’t wait to challenge the Hollow Hive, but let’s not forget the other three worlds. Living Entrails, Toxic Sea and Magnetic Fields all got new locations to explore. So revisit them, especially if you’ve yet to best the Apex Viruses at the end of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/500c372fa625d56b90a92f96fbe2b9d960c4faa1.png[/img]

Remember, after each defeated Apex Virus your subsequent runs will get harder. You only need to beat three Apexes to face the Core, so choose your path wisely!

Along with new content, this update also brings some improvements: 
[list]
[*] Updated Hunter UI
[*] Updated Mutation Shop UI
[*] Better homing on deflected projectiles
[*] Increased base healing amount when resting at a Safe Point
[*] Reduced Gunslinger turret duration
[*] Fixed bug causing interaction messages not properly disappearing after exiting to the menu
[/list]
We’re excited to bring you this update and are looking forward to your feedback. Have fun and [url=https://discord.gg/n7ua6jkvNv]stay in touch[/url]!

notes.title: Deflector's Massive Update!
notes.content:
The release of Specimen One introduced a new system that we’re finally ready to present to everyone! 
There are several key changes that we want to highlight.

[h1][b]Hub Progression[/b][/h1] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/a63af255a250d4e188a24d1fa65cc313fb79179a.png[/img]

We’ve remade the hub progression, only leaving fun and meaningful upgrades that would make your runs more interesting. Because of such a massive change we’re going to refund all the points for the previous upgrades with some adjustments due to the size of the upgrade table.

[h1][b]Run Progression[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/7eaf56cc2bb6b6073e13d8ab00dab2e2e4661d7e.jpg[/img]

The progression on the game map was streamlined due to the changes in the reward drops. We wanted to make sure that players always have a choice and would try more challenging maps for a better chance of reward.

[h1][b]Mutation Table[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/7cca850f39a72505a45e98ca9fbc36930029767f.png[/img]

When changing mutation table we wanted to make sure that our puzzle-like DNA progression will make the run progression fun and meaningful. 

You will be using three things during your run progression:

[b]Mutations[/b]
Mutations are your awesome skills that change your gameplay depending on what you pick. Decoys, explosions, giant boomerangs and more.

[b]Strands[/b]
These blank hexagonal connections will help you reach different traits and give you more freedom of choosing where to go.

[b]Traits[/b]
Previously known as alterations, these were remade as [b]Traits[/b] that grant different effects. They exist to help you fine-tune your build during the run. To activate the traits you need to place [b]Mutation[/b] or [b]Strand[/b] near it and then it will open more alterations around it! Duplicate Traits improve the overall effects.


Roguelite progression inside roguelite!

[h1][b]Reward Drops[/b][/h1]

The entire drop system was overhauled to better fit the systems higher. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/e09863b6109a1e560e6f1da7e85c61a2a988d585.png[/img]

[b]Cells[/b]
This is the currency you can use in shops.

[b]DNA[/b]
This is used to upgrade everything in the Hub.

[b]Virus Samples[/b]
This is used to open new droppable Mutations.

Additionally rooms can drop blanks (with certain upgrades affecting the rate) and in rare cases mutations.

[b]The most important - you can now quit the game during the run and return from where you’ve ended.[/b]

So that’s it! Have fun in Deflector and don’t forget to leave your feedback about the new systems!


[h2][b]Here is the full patchnote:[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]New features[/b][/h3]

[b]New DNA unlocks[/b]
[list]
[*] Almost all DNA unlocks have been re-done in order to be more useful during the game. Cost has been balanced so it does not take really long to unlock them.

[b]New Traits (previously alterations)[/b]
[*] Traits have been re-done in order to grant effects that allows you to fine-tune your build.
[*] The more duplicate Traits you activate the more powerful they become.

[b]Strands added as a rewards[/b]
[*] Strands act as a blank mutation, as they can be placed in the DNA table in order to reach other traits, but do not have any other effect.

[b]New DNA table system[/b]
[*] New DNA table, together with the new reward system, allows for more customization based on the traits selected. Which lets you create different build styles based on how you place everything inside it.
[*] Table now always starts with four random initial traits. And when a trait is activated, two new traits appear close to that one (three with the upgrade).

[b]New map progression[/b]
[*] Map scheme has been remade in order to make the player’s choice more meaningful. 
[*] Paths now will have several nodes in a row, so choosing your path will play a bigger role now.

[h3][b]New drop and reward system[/b][/h3]
[*] Reward system has been completely re-done in order to avoid choosing between “short-term fun” and “long-term efficiency” and increasing “reward vs risk” decisions.
[*] Only mutations are now shown on the map.
[*] Cells drop in all rooms. Quantity increased in harder arenas.
[*] DNA now has a chance to be dropped when killing enemies. Chance increased in harder arenas.
[*] Virus samples always drop in elite rooms and after defeating a world boss.
[*] Mutations now drop in a random arena in one of the paths. Usually they appear on the more challenging routes. 
[*] Strands drop randomly in any combat room where a mutation is not dropped. Chance increases with the challenges attached to the arenas.
[*] Health orbs no longer drops but you can get more health through traits. We may add certain other ways to drop health later.
[*] A shop now can always be found in quest rooms.
[*] Dispenser added to shops. Dispenser allows you to buy unlimited amount of strands.

[b]Added new nodes on the map:[/b]
[*] [b]Safe point:[/b] you can restore health and sometimes meet interesting NPCs, so keep a close eye on this room in future updates.
[*] [b]Survival:[/b] You will need to survive waves of enemies until the timer runs out.

[h3][b]Other:[/b][/h3]
[*] Slasher costume for Specimen One added.
[*] New slasher skin is available for any player who reached 100 viruses killed in the Last Stand room in Specimen One demo.
[*] Mutation tooltips. Every time you get a duplicate mutation you’ll get a special message saying it.
[*] Preview Mutations in shop. Mutation orbs that you buy in shop will have the picture of the mutation inside the orb.
[*] Shops before the boss added. Completing the quest “The Prisoner” unlocks the pre-boss shop.
[*] Tutorial has been remade with new enemies and map.
[*] Steam achievements added 
[*] Challenge arenas has been removed. Anomalies can appear now randomly in every combat arena.
[*] Improved character collision deteaction.
[*] Saps quest is redone and now serves as an introduction to the quest system.
[*] Anomaly challenge “Wounded” is temporarily removed from the game.
[*] Arena challenges is now scaling better with the progression.
[*] Shops can now be interacted from all sides
[*] Oogles is no longer in the room when you are dropped, and lands a few seconds after.
[*] Heal amount is now displayed when the player heals from any healing source.
[*] Health orbs, DNA orbs, Virus orbs and Cell obss no longer can be purchased on shops.
[*] SFX no longer keep playing after ending the run.
[*] Active VFX now scales correctly with all resolutions
[*] Poison effect no longer blinks when passing over a rift in the ground in Toxic Sea.


[h2][b]Balance[/b][/h2]
[b]Quests[/b]

notes.title: Deflector review (early access): a chaotic roguelike with boomerangs and bugs
notes.content:
Boomerangs are cool as hell. The sleek wooden objects careen through the air in a perfect circle - in theory, at least - before returning right back to where they began in the palm of your hand. They’re something that fascinated me as a child, and 20-something years later I still don’t really know how or why they work.

Deflector is like someone taped two swords to a boomerang, Mad Max-style. How does the boomerang still operate with twin blades slashing back and forth on either end? Don’t know. How does it always circle its way back to where you’re standing after dashing around an arena filled with enemies? Not a clue.
